*The One Rule:* 3d6 + Attribute + Skill + Modifiers

== Combat Quick-Reference

=== Your Turn

#figure(align(center)[#table(
  columns: (30.30%, 30.30%, 39.39%),

  [*Maneuver*], [1], [Basic maneuvers or a weapon maneuver],

  [*Free*], [Unlimited], [Talk, draw weapon, drop item, gesture],
)], kind: table, numbering: none, outlined: false)

*Trading:* Action → Movement or Maneuver. Never Maneuver → Action.

=== Effects

Effects resolve by tier, never a second roll. Card text defines which tiers carry which effect. One roll resolves both damage and effect.

#figure(align(center)[#table(
  columns: (47.06%, 52.94%),
  align: (auto, auto,),
  table.header([Effect], [Meaning],),
  [*Push X*], [Move the target X feet away from you],
  [*Slide X*], [Move the target X feet in any direction],
  [*Trip*], [The target falls Prone],
  [*Lift X*], [Raise the target X feet; Restrained while held],
)], kind: table, numbering: none, outlined: false)

== Character Creation Checklist

+ *Concept:* One sentence. Who is your hero?
+ *Attributes:* Assign -2 to +2. Total must be +3.
+ *Ancestry:* Human, Elf, Dwarf, or Halfling. Record Discipline and trait.
+ *Culture:* Choose upbringing. Record +1 skill bonus and Disciplines.
+ *Background DP:* 8 + Knowledge + Fortitude. Spend all on Novice skills and abilities.
+ *Class:* Choose class. Record Class Discipline and signature ability.
+ *Class DP:* 8 DP. Spend all on Novice skills and abilities.
+ *Equipment:* Take class starting kit. Record weapon properties and armor DR.
+ *Derived Stats:* HP, Initiative, Speed, Carry Slots.
+ *Backstory:* Motivation, Trinket, Name.

== DP Cost Reference

Cards (skills, abilities, spells) cost a flat rate regardless of class:

#figure(align(center)[#table(
  columns: (52.63%, 47.37%),
  align: (auto, auto,),
  table.header([Purchase], [DP Cost],),
  [Skill (Novice)], [2 DP],
  [Skill (Adept)], [4 DP],
  [Skill (Master)], [8 DP],
  [Ability (Novice)], [2 DP],
  [Ability (Adept)], [4 DP],
  [Ability (Master)], [8 DP],
  [No-prereq basic (Novice)], [2 DP],
)], kind: table, numbering: none, outlined: false)

Disciplines cost different amounts depending on your class's cost structure for that discipline:

#figure(align(center)[#table(
  columns: (28.95%, 15.79%, 15.79%, 15.79%, 23.68%),
  align: (auto, auto, auto, auto, auto,),
  table.header([Structure], [Rank 1], [Rank 2], [Rank 3], [Meaning],),
  [*Home*], [1 DP], [2 DP], [4 DP], [Favored: core to the class],
  [*Adjacent*], [2 DP], [4 DP], [8 DP], [Related but not core],
  [*Foreign*], [3 DP], [6 DP], [12 DP], [Unrelated to the class],
  [*Opposed*], [4 DP], [8 DP], [16 DP], [Antithetical to the class],
)], kind: table, numbering: none, outlined: false)

See your class's Discipline Cost Table in @sec-chapter-classes for per-discipline costs.

The total cost of a card = its flat card DP cost + the sum of the discipline rank costs for each required discipline.

#pagebreak()

== Damage Budget

All spells, abilities, and monster attacks use flat damage values. No damage dice. The hit/casting roll IS the damage roll.

#figure(align(center)[#table(

  [*Adept* (C3–6)], [6], [9], [12],
  [*Master* (C7+)], [9], [15], [21],
)], kind: table, numbering: none, outlined: false)
